definitions.escapes: Policy violations present in the draft a run would send (mas/domain.py check_draft).
definitions.success: An order succeeds when the extracted fields match the lead's truth, the band matches the expected band, and the final draft is policy clean (mas/domain.py grade).
definitions.tokens: mas/tokens.py approximation over serialized messages, labelled as such.
definitions.tokens_per_success: Total tokens across all 12 orders divided by successful orders.

capstone_system.fixed_before_build: 2026-11-06, in Lesson 29, before any capstone code was written (Lesson 30). Thresholds were set from the Lesson 03 single-agent baseline and the Lesson 24 cost table, not from the capstone's own results.
capstone_system.scenario: Fernhill lead processing: all 12 fixture orders, each extracted, scored, drafted, and checked under the reply policy in fixtures/policy.json.
